ios.desc:
You know that feeling when a movie is on the tip of your tongue but you can't remember the name? What Did I Watch? is the AI-powered movie finder that solves that problem instantly—just describe it and we'll identify it.
Simply describe the plot, remember a scene, hum a song, or talk about that weird actor you can't name. Our AI instantly identifies movies, TV shows, and anime from your description. No more nights lost to the "what was that movie" debate.
Features:

AI Movie Identification – Describe any movie, TV show, or anime and our AI identifies it instantly
Voice Input – Just talk about the film you're trying to remember; no typing required
20 Languages – Use the app in your native language; we support global audiences
Movie Posters & Details – See cover art, ratings, genres, and full information instantly
Where to Watch – Find exactly where to stream or watch the movie right now
Film Recognition – The most advanced movie recognition technology available
Multiple Formats – Identify Hollywood films, international cinema, anime, documentaries, and more
Instant Search – Get results in seconds using our AI movie search engine

Whether you're trying to recall that one scene you loved, identify a movie from a vague memory, or discover where to finally watch that show everyone's been talking about—What Did I Watch? has your back.
Perfect for:

Movie night planning
Settling debates with friends ("no, it's definitely the one with...")
Remembering that incredible film from 2015
Finding anime you watched years ago
Discovering where to stream it legally

Real user stories:

Sarah described a scene and found the exact movie she'd been searching for for years
Marcus used voice input to identify a childhood favorite while commuting
Jenny used it in Spanish to find a classic film she grew up with

With support for movies across all genres and eras—from classic Hollywood to the latest releases—What Did I Watch? is the ultimate movie finder app. Whether you describe a movie, remember a scene, or just want an AI that understands film as well as you do, we've got it covered.
Stop saying "what was that movie?" Start knowing.
